# Strikes That Fade for Real

Version 1.20.2 makes the map fade strike markers with their age, and fixes several smaller problems on the radar, the history chart and the map height.

## The map

- **Strike markers fade with their age.** _[#133]_ The markers were meant to become fainter as a strike gets older, but they all stayed fully opaque. Now a new strike is solid and an older one is fainter, and the fade survives panning and zooming.
- **The fade follows the intended curve.** _[#138]_ The fade was practically linear. Strikes now fade faster at first and then level off: with a 60 minute period, a strike 15 minutes old has an opacity of about 0.62 (before 0.75), at 30 minutes about 0.38 (before 0.50), and at 50 minutes about 0.12 (before 0.17). New strikes are still fully visible and the end of the period is still invisible.
- **A bare `map_height` number works.** _[#135]_ With `map_height: 400` the map disappeared, because a number without a unit is not a valid CSS height. A bare number now means pixels. Values with a unit, such as `50vh`, work as before.

## The radar and the history chart

- **The outer ring sits at your radius.** _[#137]_ The grid rings follow round steps, so with a radius of 75 km the last ring was drawn at 60 km and strikes between 60 and 75 km lay outside every ring. The configured radius is now drawn as the outer ring, with its label.
- **The history chart keeps moving.** _[#136]_ The bars were only redrawn when new data arrived, so on a quiet day they stood still until the next strike or a page reload. The chart now redraws every minute.

## Keyboard and screen readers

- **Links and icons can be reached with the keyboard.** _[#139]_ The compass entity links, the last-strike link, the demo badge and the help icons in the editor were skipped by Tab. They can now be focused, show a focus ring, and are activated with Enter or Space.

## Also in this release

- **Fewer requests to Home Assistant.** _[#134]_ The card asked for the 90-day statistics on every update of any entity. It now asks when its settings or its counter entity change, and at most every 10 minutes otherwise.
- **Tests and tooling.** A Playwright end-to-end suite, a build without type warnings for the test helper, and hardened GitHub workflows. Nothing changes for the card.

## Upgrading

Nothing to do after updating. Your configuration stays as it is. If you use a `map_height` without a unit, it now takes effect as pixels. After the update, reload the dashboard so the new card file is loaded.

Requirements are unchanged: Home Assistant 2026.6 or newer.
